Name: Terraria Accessories
Author: Vladislavjzk
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Compatible with Stardew Valley v1.6![/size]
[/b][size=5][b]Adds 18 new Terraria accessories.[/b]
[/size][/center][size=4][size=4][b]Installation & Usage:[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Download the zipped file, and unzip its full contents into your Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.[/size]
[/list][/size]
[size=4][b]How to get every accessory:[/b]
[spoiler]Shackle, Obsidian Skull, Anklet of the Wind, Band of Regeneration, Cobalt Shield - Sold by Marlon

Power Glove, Obsidian Shield, Mechanical Glove, Destroyer Emblem, Obsidian Horseshoe - Craftable (Combat levels 6-9)

Hermes Boots and Cross Necklace - Traded from Desert Trader

Titan Glove and Avenger Emblem - Sold by Dwarf

Eye of the Golem and Feral Claws - Sold by Casino

Lucky Horseshoe - Traded from Island Trader

Magic Conch - Sold by Willy (requires 6 hearts with him)
[/spoiler]
[b]
Accessories description:[/b]
[spoiler]Anklet of the Wind - Increases speed by 0.5.

Hermes Boots: Increases speed by 1.

Band of Regeneration: Regenerates 1 health every 10 seconds.

Cobalt Shield: Increases defense by 3 and immunity by 2.

Cross Necklace: Increases invincibility time after taking damage by 2 seconds.

Eye of the Golem: Increases critical strike chance by 20%.

Feral Claws: Increases weapon speed by 20%.

Lucky Horseshoe: Increases luck by 2.

Obsidian Skull: Increases defense by 2 and immunity by 1.

Obsidian Shield: Increases defense by 5 and immunity by 3.

Mechanical Glove: Increases weapon speed and attack by 20%, and knockback by 40%.

Power Glove: Increases weapon speed by 20% and knockback by 40%.

Titan Glove: Increases knockback by 40%.

Shackle: Increases defense by 2.

Avenger Emblem: Increases attack by 20%.

Destroyer Emblem: Increases attack and critical strike chance by 20%.

Obsidian Horseshoe: Increases defense and luck by 2, and immunity by 1.

Magic Conch: Teleports you to the beach.
[/spoiler][/size]
[size=4][b]Rings effects do not stack.[/b][/size]
[b][size=4]All art is from the official Terraria wiki.[/size][/b]
